title: Privacy policy | How Handoff handles your information
seoDescription: How Handoff collects, uses and protects information from www.talenthandoff.com, including the contact form, call booking, job applications and analytics.
headline: Privacy policy
draftNotice: Draft for legal review. This policy is not in effect yet. Items in [brackets] need Handoff's confirmation.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: This policy explains how Your Handoff LLC, a California limited liability company ("Handoff," "we," "us"), collects, uses and shares information through our website, www.talenthandoff.com. Handoff places full-time Latin American professionals with US companies.
If you have a question about this policy or your information, contact us at hello@talenthandoff.com.

sections.heading: Information you give us
paragraphs: We collect the information you choose to send us:
bullets: Contact form: your name, work email, company, the role you're hiring for, how many people you need, your timeline and any message you add.

Discovery call booking: after you send the contact form, you can book a call through Cal.com. Your name, email and form answers are passed to the booking so you don't have to type them again, along with the time you pick.
Job applications: our open positions page shows our job board from Ashby. When you apply, Ashby collects your application for us, and Ashby's privacy policy also applies.
Emails you send to us at hello@talenthandoff.com.

sections.heading: Information collected automatically
paragraphs: When you visit the site, we use Google Analytics, loaded through Google Tag Manager, to understand how the site is used. It records things like the pages you visit, how you arrived, your browser and device type, your approximate location based on your IP address, and some interactions, such as scrolling, clicks on outside links and video plays. Google Analytics uses cookies to do this.
Our hosting provider, Vercel, keeps standard server logs, including IP addresses and browser details, to run and secure the site.

sections.heading: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use the information described above to:
bullets: Answer your inquiry and schedule the calls you book
Provide our recruiting and staffing services, including reviewing job applications
Understand how the site is used and improve it
Keep the site secure and prevent misuse

sections.heading: How we share your information
paragraphs: We don't sell your personal information. We share it only with the service providers that help us run the site and our business, and only as needed for them to do that work:
bullets: Google (Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager and Google Workspace email)

sections.heading: Other disclosures
paragraphs: We may also share information if the law requires it, to protect our rights or the safety of others, or as part of a merger, acquisition or sale of all or part of our business.

sections.heading: Cookies and your choices
paragraphs: Google Analytics only sets its cookies after you accept them in the cookie banner. You can change your choice anytime with Cookie Settings in the footer.

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, and you can opt out of Google Analytics with Google's browser add-on at tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout. The site still works without these cookies.
If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control signal, we treat it as declining analytics cookies. The site doesn't currently respond to browser Do Not Track signals.

sections.heading: How long we keep information
paragraphs: We keep personal information only as long as we need it for the purposes above, or longer if the law requires it. Google Analytics keeps detailed event data for the retention period set in our Analytics account, after which Google deletes it.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete your personal information, to object to or limit how we use it, and to receive a copy of it. This includes rights under US state privacy laws, such as California's, Brazil's LGPD, and data protection laws in other countries where we work, in the Latin American countries where we work.
To make a request, email hello@talenthandoff.com. We may need to confirm your identity before we act on it. We won't treat you differently for using these rights.

sections.heading: International transfers
paragraphs: We work with people in the United States and Latin America, and our service providers may process information in the United States and other countries.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information. No website or system is completely secure, so please don't send sensitive information, such as government ID numbers or financial details, through the contact form or by email.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: The site is meant for businesses and working professionals. It isn't directed at anyone under 18, and we don't knowingly collect their information.

sections.heading: Other websites
paragraphs: The site links to other services, such as LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Cal.com and Ashby. Their own privacy policies apply when you use them.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy. When we do, we'll change the effective date at the top of this page.
